label: SYNTHETIC
what: Swing, spin, glide and false-wind characterisation of sim/nav/truth.py parachute descents
warning: The canopy normal-force law is a generic assumed shape, not a measured canopy.
false_wind_definition: w_hat = u + tau du/dt with u the IMU-point horizontal velocity, a centred difference of the 100 Hz truth and tau = mean descent speed / g; error against the true wind at the payload centre of mass; naive is w_hat = u. RMS values are per horizontal axis (east and north pooled).

literature.label: figures supplied with the task, not re-verified
literature.tutt_aiaa_2013_1384: 3.6 m extended-skirt canopy: average oscillation 20-27 deg, maximum 25-33 deg, 0.29-0.45 Hz (data from WADD AFTR 5867)
literature.nasa_sp_8066: small models are less stable than large; 10-15 deg pendular or coning motion is normally acceptable

groups.class: the three classes the navigation Monte Carlo uses, turbulent wind
groups.calm: calm-air repeats: true wind is zero, all air-relative motion is self-induced
groups.dt_check: moderate class, 14 s, same descents at three integration steps
groups.decay: calm air, start tilt sd 20 deg and rate sd 60 deg/s; decay measured from t = 0
groups.line_benign: line length sweep at cn_k 1.0, trim 0 (0.45 m is mc_benign)
groups.line_moderate: line length sweep at cn_k 0.4, trim 12 deg (0.45 m is mc_moderate)
groups.added_mass: apparent mass sweep at cn_k 0.4, trim 12 deg (0.008 kg is mc_moderate)
groups.extra: OUTSIDE the requested grid: cn_k 0.1 restoring canopy driven by the random canopy side force (side_force_sd 0.05 N, correlation time 0.5 s) that truth.py provides

dt_check.note: Winds and starting states are identical (same seed). The random spin torque is drawn once per step, so its realisation differs with the step; spin_rms_dps therefore differs by sampling noise, not by integration error, and is left out of largest_relative_difference.
